final.narration: Recent field measurements sit 33.1 % below the rating, so published flows are about that much too high since 2024-12-17. The best guess is an uncertain datum change. The field note from 2024-12-17 reads "Scour control changed", but they disagree because scour normally pushes residuals positive, while measurements are below the rating and velocity dropped more than area. Double-check: Run a level survey from the bench mark to the gage and inspect the control for scour/fill displacement and any shifted reference marks. Trust score 24/100 (Stale).

final.skeptic_argument: The top cause is datum_change, and the evidence is still not strong enough to outweigh the control note: the residual is -33.1% and the shift is -0.327 ft, but the channel comparison shows velocity fell 22.1% while area only fell 11.3%, which is more consistent with backwater/fill than a pure datum shift. The field note says 'Scour control changed,' so I accept the note only as a competing explanation, not as proof against a datum issue.
